tweets.text:
ARRESTED: PAISAS GANG MEMBER ❗
 
A previously deported felon tried to slip past agents at a USBP Immigration Checkpoint in Marathon, TX. During questioning, the Mexican national admitted he had been deported before and had no legal documents to be in the U.S. He also admitted to being an active member of the Paisas prison gang. Record checks confirmed more- he has a conviction for possession with intent to distribute meth.
 
He is now facing federal charges for felony illegal reentry- then deportation.

@Usbpchiefbbt
